scripts.build: bun run check && rm -rf dist.new && bun build src/index.html --outdir=dist.new --production --public-path=/ --chunk-naming='assets/[name]-[hash].[ext]' --asset-naming='assets/[name]-[hash].[ext]' && rm -rf dist.old && (test -d dist && mv dist dist.old || true) && mv dist.new dist && rm -rf dist.old
